run_azure_api_benchmark: run the Azure API benchmark script to measure LLM inference performance across concurrency levels
generate_random_prompt: create a random prompt of a specified token count using the model tokenizer vocabulary
generate_text: send a text generation request to the Azure API endpoint and measure latency and token count
evaluate_performance: evaluate LLM inference performance metrics including P50/P99 latency, RPS, and tokens per second
review_benchmark_script: review the Azure API benchmark script for correctness and performance measurement accuracy
